title: Four in a Row
intro: Visitors play Four in a Row from their phones against the computer or a friend, and the board shows on a matrix of the show while a game is on: 7 columns of 6 discs, as big as fit, with a strip on top in the colour of whose turn it is. Pick the matrix, then Save.

fields.text: Against a friend (a second phone joins)

fields.label: Seconds to wait for a friend
Seconds of party at the end

fields.text: 😢 When someone loses (or the computer wins)

fields.label: 🔊 Sound
options: Built in: a fanfare for a win, a "wah wah" for a loss

fields.label: My own sound for a win (a WAV file on this computer)
My own sound for a loss

fields.text: 🗣️ Say the words out loud (the computer's own voice, after the sound)

fields.label: Voice language (en, pt, es…; the computer must have that voice)

fields.text: 🔤 Write the words across the lights
🫧 A machine for a few seconds (bubbles, fog, snow, lights…)

fields.label: How the app reaches the machine
options: Web address (smart plug, relay, Shelly, Tasmota)
DMX through EZPlayer (a model in the layout)
DMX by DDP (WLED or a board with a DMX output)
DMX by E1.31 / sACN (a DMX node)

fields.text: Web address: also when someone loses

fields.label: DMX by DDP / Art-Net / E1.31: the board's IP address
DMX through EZPlayer: the show's models (tap the machine's model)
DMX for a loss (empty: the machine stays off; e.g. only a red light 5=255, 6=255)
The machine rests between two (seconds)
fields.hint: Every other DMX channel is 0, and all go back to 0 at the end. The fun README explains each way of reaching a machine, and DMX channels.
